exposure: Multimodality local anesthetic protocol for hysteroscopy
outcome: Premature termination rate due to pain
cohort: 569 women undergoing office-based diagnostic or operative hysteroscopic procedures
finding: A multimodality local anesthetic protocol for office-based hysteroscopy effectively manages pain, allowing for successful completion of both diagnostic and operative procedures while reducing costs.
mod_finding: Women who had both cesarean and vaginal delivery had higher pain scores than the mean.
